Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3929); Lamech (i.e. Lemek), a patriarch:--Lamech.
BiblicalUsage: Lamech appears once, in the genealogy of Jesus in Luke 3:36: Noah "was the son of Lamech," and Lamech was the son of Methuselah. He is the Lamech who lived seven hundred and seventy-seven years and died five years before the flood, the father of Noah, whose name means rest.
TheologicalSignificance: To my mind, Lamech's one verse holds the whole hope of the genealogy: the father of Noah, whose son would bring rest from the curse, and whose name stands in the line that leads to Christ.
